messages:
maria-cs: Novara reported a sudden burst this AM — multiple 429s and p95 latency jumping to 2.1s between 08:12-08:25 UTC. Their dedicated pool novara-prod-eu is returning throttles. Baseline QPS ~180, peak ~950 during the spike, they expected to be covered by current commit. :worried:

tara-support: Got it. Can you paste a sample request id + timeframe? Also any billing/auth errors or strictly 429/latency?

maria-cs: sample request id: req_20260310_0816_9f3a. No auth/billing errors reported, purely 429 and higher latencies from our side. Customer says it started right after a marketing push.

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] 2026-03-10T08:15:30Z scale_attempt novara-prod-eu desired=6 max=6 -> blocked_by_quota (max_nodes reached).

sanjay-eng: quick triage notes: metrics show queue_length climbed and GPU utilization hit 96% on most nodes. Autoscaler tried to scale at ~08:15 but never exceeded max_nodes=6. Their pool config targets 65% utilization with burst allowance but current max prevents scale. Also saw a few pods with large batch_size param (B=128) causing long queuing on KV cache writes — possible noisy neighbor effect.

sanjay-eng: PromQL snippets I used:
```
max_over_time(inference_gpu_utilization[10m]) by (node)
rate(requests_total{pool="novara-prod-eu"}[1m])
avg_over_time(queue_length{pool="novara-prod-eu"}[5m])
```

ops-oncall: Immediate mitigation options:
- increase pool max_nodes to 10 (fast)
- reduce per-request batch_size for the tenant or apply per-tenant resource limits
- enable temporary routing to hosted fallback for non-sensitive traffic
Which do you want me to run now?

tara-support: Please do the max_nodes bump first, and enable hosted fallback for non-critical routes if we can toggle it quickly. I'll message Novara with ETA and ask them to pause the campaign if possible. :+1:

ops-oncall: Running override now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl pools update --name novara-prod-eu --max-nodes 10 --reason "emergency scale for Novara campaign"
```

deploy-bot: [pools] change_applied novara-prod-eu max_nodes 10 desired=8 (rolling up) at 2026-03-10T08:18:42Z.

ops-oncall: Monitoring -- queue length dropping, GPU util back to ~70% after new instances came up. No further 429s reported to support channel for the last 6m.

sanjay-eng: Follow-ups (post-incident):
- schedule a capacity review with Novara: baseline they told us earlier was under-provisioned for marketing spikes (we should validate their expected peak vs reserve policy)
- recommend changing their autoscale policy: raise max_nodes, shorten scale_up cooldown, and set a hard headroom target of 25% (i.e., target_util=0.6)
- consider isolating heavy-batch workloads into separate node-pools or enforcing batch_size limits at routing layer to prevent single tenant from saturating GPUs

maria-cs: I'll coordinate a meeting and share the proposed defaults (reserve 25% headroom, max_nodes >= projected_peak/throughput_per_node). Customer is relieved the errors stopped, but wants assurance it won't recur.

tara-support: Closing loop: applied emergency increase, no more 429s observed, ops will revert override into a permanent pool config after review. Filing follow-up ticket for capacity planning with Novara. :white_check_mark:
